name: dsh-memory-system
description: Local-first persistent memory infrastructure for DeepSeek Harness: bounded hot-memory bootstrap, explainable cold recall (exact + Chinese BM25), lease-lock transactional writes, read-only governance, and trajectory review. Pure Python + Markdown, zero external dependencies.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check bridge.js && node --test test_plugin_bridge.test.mjs && python -c "import glob,py_compile; [py_compile.compile(f, doraise=True) for f in glob.glob('vault-guard/*.py')+glob.glob('plugins/evidence-ledger/*.py')]" && python -m unittest discover -s vault-guard -p "test_*.py"
